SUMMARY

I am an Immediate Joiner, An experienced professional with over 7+ years of experience in finance, risk, data, modeling, and analytics. Holds advanced qualifications including an MBA in Finance and a Master’s in Business Economics. Has successfully led and contributed to multiple engagements and projects involving Risk Management, Risk operations, model audit, model governance, and model risk management. Analytics, model development, Well-versed in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) data and transforming it into actionable insights. Proficient in data ops, analytics, project management and leadership, Advanced Excel + VBA, and Strong understanding of financial markets, products, credit, treasury, actuaries and statistics, with additional experience in climate risk and weather data modeling.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Assistant Manager – Risk Consulting Grant Thornton Bharat LLP – Mumbai | September 2024 to January 2026

Risk Operations and Management | Modelling | Stress testing | Macro Economic Modelling | Model Governance and Risk Management framework (SR-11/7, PRA SS1/23, CBUAE - MMS & MMG) | Business Risk | Valuations & VAR Model | Model Audit & process governance | IRRBB | NMD, EVE & NII | Market and Credit Risk | Stakeholder management and presentation

Led the development of a Model Risk Management (MRM) and Governance Framework for a large public sector bank, aligned with global regulatory standards and industry best practices.

Engaged with Risk, Model Validation, Compliance, and business stakeholders to understand existing governance processes, regulatory requirements, and operating challenges.

Gathered and documented business requirements for model governance framework enhancement initiatives and control improvements.

Prepared functional and business documentation, including requirement documents, process notes, governance artefacts, and implementation recommendations.

Conducted detailed gap analysis of existing policies, procedures, and controls against regulatory expectations and industry best practices.

Developed a structured Gap Analysis Matrix, remediation roadmap, and supporting governance documentation.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to ensure requirements were translated into actionable solutions and implementation plans.

Presented framework recommendations, gap assessment findings, and implementation approach to the CRO and Risk Management leadership team.

AMC Repo Clearing Ltd – Assistant Manager, Risk Management

Assistant Manager - Risk Management AMC Repo Clearing Ltd – Mumbai | July 2023 to September 2024

Risk Operations | Cover Counter Party & Credit Risk for CCP | Fixed Income securities Analytics | Repo / CBLO | Corporate Bonds & Debentures | Credit Risk modeling | Back testing | Stress Testing | Liquidity Stress test | Risk monitoring. | PFMI | BA - BRD & UAT • Acted as a Business Analyst between Risk, Operations, and Technology teams for risk management system

enhancements.

Conducted requirement gathering discussions with business users to understand operational and risk management requirements.

Prepared BRDs and FRDs for enhancements related to Initial Margin, Stress Testing, Exposure Monitoring, and Risk Reporting processes.

Coordinated with technology teams during requirement clarification, development, testing, and implementation phases.

Participated in UAT planning and execution, validating system functionality against business requirements and operational expectations.

Supported daily system monitoring, issue resolution, and post-implementation validation activities.

Actuarial & Risk Analyst Wingsure Technology Pvt Ltd – Remote | January 2022 to July 2023

Weather based parametric Insurance Product - Pricing & Risk model Devp. |Pricing review & Back testing | Buss. Profit testing | Statistics | Python & ML | Risk optimization | Dashboard-Analytics | Climate-related Physical and financial risk | CAT Modelling & Stress testing on climate parameter and financial loss test | Rural Credit model development | Insurance Risk Management

GI - Crop and Agriculture Product development & pricing model development: Developed pricing models using methods such as Burning Cost, Frequency & Severity, and Expected Loss for a weather-based parametric insurance product. Calculated pure/actuarial premiums and conducted pricing reviews through back-testing and cost analysis. Evaluated market feasibility and consumer affordability, validated fairness of the pure premium, and assessed product performance and expected loss ratios.

Profi & Loss testing: Assessed product profitability and premium collection potential using secondary market research data. Prepared the client’s business model and loss tests like Average Annual Loss (AAL) and Probable Maximum Loss (PML)

Risk analysis on Verisk: Conducted CAT - climate risk assessments using 10,000 simulated scenarios to calculate risk parameters such as Expected Loss (EL), Expected shortfall, Tail Value at Risk (TVaR), Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR), basis risk, and loss forecasting. Incorporated climate variables into the financial model to quantify loss impact -

Climate variables integration in credit model : Integrated climate-related variables into the agricultural credit application

scorecard model to estimate and capture climate basis risk affecting farmers’ application scores, and incorporated this impact into the Probability of Default (PD).

Executive - Corporate Finance & Strategy Continuum Green Energy Pvt Ltd. – Mumbai | January 2020 to October 2020

Financial Modeling & Budgeting | Fixed Income / Credit Analysis & Rating | Project Finance | New Business Proposals | Capital Structure and fund raising - Equity / Debt - Loan/ Bonds. | Climate Parameter estimation & Assessment | ESG

Part of the Corporate Finance team, involved in core financial activities including financial statement analysis, ratio analysis, scenario-based modeling and budgeting, project finance and fund raising, preparation of detailed project reports (DPRs) and new business proposals, and working on group company projects.

Forecasting weather parameters such as wind (for wind mills) and sunshine hours (for solar power) and incorporating them

into financial models to calculate revenue generation from electricity, along with ESG reporting.

Stress testing weather parameters to capture changes in weather patterns and assess potential economic losses to the business

and headwinds in electricity generation for our renewable energy projects.

Financial Modeling & Analysis: Building financial models for various operating projects and forecasting business cost and revenue items (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement). Analyzing business KPIs and maintaining, forecasting, and analyzing key ratios such as DSCR and ICR.

Research Analyst (Market Research & Analytics team) CRISIL Ltd (An S&P Global Co.) - Mumbai | August 2018 to November 2019

Client Analytics team: Data analytics, modelling, equity research, business insight, market risk.



Provided analytical services to Investment banks across Global and Regional offices on operating performance across various Investment and Financial products also, Investigating, analyzing, and making in-depth analysis of data.



Fundamental research, industry KPI, business KPI, key financial component analysis financial modeling & investment research report, PPTs



Provided valuable, market leading business analytics, competitor benchmarking services, strategic insights to clients, portfolio analytics etc.



Full-fledged quantitative model development / validation / upgradation, extensively working on excel based advance model, interactive dashboard.

INTERNSHIP

Motilal Oswal Securities Ltd - Mumbai, Maharashtra | January 2018 to July 2018 Market Research & Analysis





Constructing Portfolio by selection of various stocks, Stimulating the portfolio in money control, daily tracking. benchmark as Nifty, Calculating the Alpha and Beta of the Portfolio. Providing short stock research notes and buy/sell Recommendation to trader/investors, assist senior in Building and updating financial models.

Organizing various events to get more prospective clients. Engaging with Existing and new Clients for new investments in financial products.

Asit C. Mehta Investment Intermediaries – Mumbai | May 2017 to June 2017 Research & Strategy

Role involved for Business research. • • • Research for creating a trading platform for our online trading app and recent market trends in discount brokerage. Competitor Analysis for our Online Trading App for Zero Discount Brokerage Study Zero Discount Brokerage firms there pricing policy, brokerage plan, marketing strategy etc.
